messages:
Yana Mirza: Hey folks — first day! joining APAC infra team. Wave 👋 I'm Yana (she/her), IST (GMT+5:30). Quick q: who should I ping for MDM/SSH access and getting added to the dedicated GPU pool?
Jamie Liu: Welcome Yana!!! :tada: I'll add you to #eng-apac and infra-team. Buddy is @Anika — she'll DM you. For infra resources ping infra-ops, and for MDM ping Devon.
Anika Patel: hi Yana!! I'll be your buddy. DMing you now. For the GPU pool we usually need: 1) Okta group 'redwood:dedicated-gpu', 2) a signed request for project quota. I can help file it. Also which sticker pack do you want? 😄
Devon Chen: Hi Yana — I'm IT. For MDM enroll, try CompanyPortal -> Sign in with SSO -> Enroll. If that errors, paste the exact error. If you're on mac, try this diagnostic and paste output:
```
/Applications/CompanyPortal.app/Contents/MacOS/CompanyPortal --diagnostic > cp-diagnose.log
cat cp-diagnose.log | tail -n 40
```
That helps us see the 403 vs cert issue.
Yana Mirza: Thanks — trying enroll now. Getting "Enrollment failed (403): device not authorized". I restarted and reinstalled CompanyPortal already. Laptop serial is C02YNA1234JK.
Devon Chen: Thanks. I submitted a device allowlist request. Meanwhile can you confirm you're on your home ISP or corporate VPN? Home ISP should work; corp firewall might block. Also try one more thing: open a browser, go to https://sso.redwood-infra.com and confirm you can login with SSO.
Yana Mirza: On home network, SSO works fine. Getting an "unauthorized device" on CompanyPortal only.
MDM Bot: Device allowlist request submitted (req-2026-482). IT will update you in ~30m.
Anika Patel: I'll start the GPU quota request with infra-ops now and cc Jamie. Also fun icebreaker: Yana — tell us one fun fact (we do a tiny welcome tradition).
Luis Ortega: Welcome! Also FYI we try to sync an APAC lunch meetup every other Thursday — would you be up for that? 🍜
Yana Mirza: Love the lunch idea. Fun fact: I brew kombucha, I did a small improv tour in uni, and I've lived in 6 countries. Two truths and one lie — guess away!
Jamie Liu: Hmm I'm guessing improv is the lie?
Anika Patel: I'm guessing kombucha is a lie (but want it to be true) 😅
Devon Chen: I bet the 6 countries is true. Welcome again Yana — I'll ping once enrollment is done. If anything blocks your laptop, shout here and I'll jump on a call.
Yana Mirza: Thanks everyone — really appreciate the warm welcome. I'll drop the serial and the diagnostic output here if the MDM bot asks. Looking forward to working with you all! :coffee:
